timer.presets_menu: Timer widget right-click submenu listing the quick-start durations (Settings › Timer). Picking one sets that time and starts the timer. Short.
sw.cat_menu: Stopwatch right-click submenu to pick the time category (Focus / Other). One word.
sw.reset_total_menu: Stopwatch right-click item: the category total starts counting from zero now. Nothing is deleted; the log keeps all past time. Short.
sw.laps_menu: Stopwatch right-click submenu listing the recorded laps. {n} is how many. Short.
pomo.settings_menu: Pomodoro right-click item that opens its settings panel (lengths, rounds, auto-start). Ends with an ellipsis like other items that open a panel.
away.text: Toast question when the PC slept or the user was away while a stopwatch or pomodoro kept counting. {name} is the widget type (Stopwatch, Pomodoro), {t} the time away, {cat} the category the time is recorded under (time.focus or time.other; pomodoro is always Focus). Stays up until a button is pressed. Ends with a yes/no question (record it under {cat}?) answered by away.keep / away.cut.
away.crash: Toast question after WidgetBoard closed unexpectedly while a stopwatch or pomodoro was running. {name} is the widget type, {since} the time the run started (e.g. 17:53), {cat} the category as in away.text. The app cannot tell when it closed, so the whole span from {since} to now is in question.
away.keep: Toast button: count the time in question in the time record. One word.
away.cut: Toast button: leave the time in question out of the time record. 1 to 2 words.
